1.english_reference: So when David was old and full of days

traditions.WLC: וְ דָוִ֥יד זָקֵ֖ן וְ שָׂבַ֣ע יָמִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: Καὶ Δαυεὶδ πρεσβύτης καὶ πλήρης ἡμερῶν ,
traditions.VUL: Igitur David , senex et plenus diérum ,
traditions.KJV: So when David was old and full of days ,

1.english_reference: he made Solomon his son king over Israel

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּמְלֵ֛ךְ אֶת שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בְנ֖ וֹ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν Σαλωμὼν τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ ἀντ᾽ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.VUL: regem constítuit Salomónem fílium suum super Israel .
traditions.KJV: he made Solomon his son king over Israel .

2.english_reference: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel , with the priests and the Levites

traditions.WLC: וַ יֶּאֱסֹף֙ אֶת כָּל שָׂרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ הַ כֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְ הַ לְוִיִּֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ συνήγαγεν τοὺς πάντας ἄρχοντας Ἰσραὴλ καὶ τοὺς ἱερεῖς καὶ τοὺς Λευείτας .
traditions.VUL: Et congregávit omnes príncipes Israel , et sacerdótes atque Levítas .
traditions.KJV: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel , with the priests and the Levites .

3.english_reference: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward :

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּסָּֽפְרוּ֙ הַ לְוִיִּ֔ם מִ בֶּ֛ן שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וָ מָ֑עְלָ ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἠρίθμησαν οἱ Λευεῖται ἀπὸ τριακονταετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω ,
traditions.VUL: Numeratíque sunt Levítæ a trigínta annis , et supra :
traditions.KJV: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward :

3.english_reference: and their number by their polls , man by man , was thirty and eight thousand .

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֨י מִסְפָּרָ֤ ם לְ גֻלְגְּלֹתָ ם֙ לִ גְבָרִ֔ים שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וּ שְׁמוֹנָ֖ה אָֽלֶף
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο ὁ ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν κατὰ κεφαλὴν αὐτῶν εἰς ἄνδρας τριάκοντα καὶ ὀκτὼ χιλιάδας ·
traditions.VUL: et invénta sunt trigínta octo míllia virórum .
traditions.KJV: and their number by their polls , man by man , was thirty and eight thousand .

4.english_reference: Of which , twenty and four thousand [ were ] to set forward the work of the house of the LORD

traditions.WLC: מֵ אֵ֗לֶּה לְ נַצֵּ֨חַ֙ עַל מְלֶ֣אכֶת בֵּית יְהוָ֔ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְ אַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָ֑לֶף
traditions.LXX: ἀπὸ τῶν ἐργοδιωκτῶν ἐπὶ τὰ ἔργα οἴκου εἴκοσι τέσσαρες χιλιάδες ,
traditions.VUL: Ex his elécti sunt , et distribúti in ministérium domus Dómini , vigínti quátuor míllia :
traditions.KJV: Of which , twenty and four thousand [ were ] to set forward the work of the house of the LORD ;

4.english_reference: and six thousand [ were ] officers and judges

traditions.WLC: וְ שֹׁטְרִ֥ים וְ שֹׁפְטִ֖ים שֵׁ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ γραμματεῖς καὶ κριταὶ ἑξακισχίλιοι ,
traditions.VUL: præpositórum autem et iúdicum sex míllia .
traditions.KJV: and six thousand [ were ] officers and judges :

traditions.WLC: וְ אַרְבַּ֥עַת אֲלָפִ֖ים שֹׁעֲרִ֑ים
traditions.VUL: Porro quátuor míllia ianitóres ,
traditions.KJV: Moreover four thousand [ were ] porters ;

5.english_reference: and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made , [ said David ] , to praise [ therewith ]

traditions.WLC: וְ אַרְבַּ֤עַת אֲלָפִים֙ מְהַֽלְלִ֣ים לַ יהוָ֔ה בַּ כֵּלִ֕ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתִי לְ הַלֵּֽל
traditions.LXX: καὶ τέσσαρες χιλιάδες αἰνοῦντες τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν τοῖς ὀργάνοις οἷς ἐποίησεν τοῦ αἰνεῖν τῷ κυρίῳ .
traditions.VUL: et tótidem psaltæ , canéntes Dómino in órganis , quæ fécerat ad canéndum .
traditions.KJV: and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made , [ said David ] , to praise [ therewith ] .

6.english_reference: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi

traditions.WLC: וַ יֶּֽחָלְקֵ֥ ם דָּוִ֖יד מַחְלְק֑וֹת לִ בְנֵ֣י לֵוִ֔י
traditions.LXX: καὶ διεῖλεν αὐτοὺς Δαυεὶδ ἐφημερίας τοῖς υἱοῖς Λευεί ,
traditions.VUL: Et distríbuit eos David per vices filiórum Levi ,
traditions.KJV: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi , [ namely ] ,

traditions.WLC: לְ גֵרְשׁ֖וֹן קְהָ֥ת וּ מְרָרִֽי
traditions.LXX: τῷ Γεδσών , Καάθ , Μαραρεί ·
traditions.VUL: Gerson vidélicet , et Caath , et Merári .
traditions.KJV: Gershon , Kohath , and Merari .

7.english_reference: Of the Gershonites [ were ] , Laadan , and Shimei

traditions.WLC: לַ גֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֖י לַעְדָּ֥ן וְ שִׁמְעִֽי
traditions.LXX: καὶ τῷ Παροσώμ , τῷ Ἐδὰν καὶ τῷ Σεμεεί .
traditions.VUL: Fílii Gerson : Léedan , et Sémei .
traditions.KJV: Of the Gershonites [ were ] , Laadan , and Shimei .

8.english_reference: The sons of Laadan ; the chief [ was ] Jehiel , and Zetham , and Joel , three

traditions.WLC: בְּנֵ֣י לַעְדָּ֗ן הָ רֹ֧אשׁ יְחִיאֵ֛ל וְ זֵתָ֥ם וְ יוֹאֵ֖ל שְׁלֹשָֽׁה
traditions.LXX: υἱοὶ τῷ Ἐδάν · ὁ ἄρχων Ἰὴλ καὶ Ζεθὸμ καὶ Ἰωήλ . καὶ τρεῖς
traditions.VUL: Fílii Léedan : princeps Iáhiel , et Zethan , et Ioel , tres .
traditions.KJV: The sons of Laadan ; the chief [ was ] Jehiel , and Zetham , and Joel , three .

9.english_reference: The sons of Shimei ; Shelomith , and Haziel , and Haran , three

traditions.WLC: בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְעִ֗י שלמות וַ חֲזִיאֵ֛ל וְ הָרָ֖ן שְׁלֹשָׁ֑ה
traditions.LXX: υἱοὶ Σεμεεί · Ἀλωθεὶμ καὶ Εἱειὴλ καὶ Αἱδάν , τρεῖς ·
traditions.VUL: Fílii Sémei : Sálomith , et Hósiel , et Aran , tres :
traditions.KJV: The sons of Shimei ; Shelomith , and Haziel , and Haran , three .

9.english_reference: These [ were ] the chief of the fathers of Laadan

traditions.WLC: אֵ֛לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֥י הָ אָב֖וֹת לְ לַעְדָּֽן
traditions.LXX: οὗτοι ἄρχοντες πατριῶν τῶν Ἐδάν .
traditions.VUL: isti príncipes familiárum Léedan .
traditions.KJV: These [ were ] the chief of the fathers of Laadan .

10.english_reference: And the sons of Shimei [ were ] , Jahath , Zina , and Jeush , and Beriah

traditions.WLC: וּ בְנֵ֣י שִׁמְעִ֔י יַ֣חַת זִינָ֔א וִ יע֖וּשׁ וּ בְרִיעָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Σεμεεί · Ἰὲθ καὶ Ζιζὰ καὶ Ἰῶας καὶ Βεριά ·
traditions.VUL: Porro fílii Sémei : Leheth , et Ziza , et Iaus , et Baría :
traditions.KJV: And the sons of Shimei [ were ] , Jahath , Zina , and Jeush , and Beriah .

10.english_reference: These four [ were ] the sons of Shimei

traditions.WLC: אֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵי שִׁמְעִ֖י אַרְבָּעָֽה
traditions.LXX: οὗτοι υἱοὶ Σεμεεί , τέσσαρες .
traditions.VUL: isti fílii Sémei , quátuor .
traditions.KJV: These four [ were ] the sons of Shimei .

11.english_reference: And Jahath was the chief , and Zizah the second

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יְהִי יַ֣חַת הָ רֹ֔אשׁ וְ זִיזָ֖ה הַ שֵּׁנִ֑י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦν Ἰὲθ ὁ ἄρχων , καὶ Ζιζὰ ὁ δεύτερος ·
traditions.VUL: Erat autem Leheth prior , Ziza secúndus :
traditions.KJV: And Jahath was the chief , and Zizah the second :

11.english_reference: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons

traditions.WLC: וִ יע֤וּשׁ וּ בְרִיעָה֙ לֹֽא הִרְבּ֣וּ בָנִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ Ἰῶας καὶ Βεριὰ οὐκ ἐπλήθυνεν υἱούς ,
traditions.VUL: porro Iaus et Baría non habuérunt plúrimos fílios ,
traditions.KJV: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons ;

11.english_reference: therefore they were in one reckoning , according to [ their ] father ’s house

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּֽהְיוּ֙ לְ בֵ֣ית אָ֔ב לִ פְקֻדָּ֖ה אֶחָֽת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο εἰς οἶκον πατριᾶς εἰς ἐπίσκεψιν μίαν .
traditions.VUL: et idcírco in una família , unáque domo computáti sunt .
traditions.KJV: therefore they were in one reckoning , according to [ their ] father ’s house .

12.english_reference: The sons of Kohath ; Amram , Izhar , Hebron , and Uzziel , four

traditions.WLC: בְּנֵ֣י קְהָ֗ת עַמְרָ֥ם יִצְהָ֛ר חֶבְר֥וֹן וְ עֻזִּיאֵ֖ל אַרְבָּעָֽה
traditions.LXX: υἱοὶ Καάθ · Ἀμβράμ , Ἰσσαάρ , Χεβρών , Ὀζειήλ , τέσσαρες .
traditions.VUL: Fílii Caath : Amram , et Isaar , Hebron , et Oziel , quátuor .
traditions.KJV: The sons of Kohath ; Amram , Izhar , Hebron , and Uzziel , four .

13.english_reference: The sons of Amram ; Aaron and Moses

traditions.WLC: בְּנֵ֥י עַמְרָ֖ם אַהֲרֹ֣ן וּ מֹשֶׁ֑ה
traditions.LXX: υἱοὶ Ἀμβράμ · Ἀαρὼν καὶ Μωσῆς .
traditions.VUL: Fílii Amram : Aaron , et Móyses .
traditions.KJV: The sons of Amram ; Aaron and Moses :

13.english_reference: and Aaron was separated , that he should sanctify the most holy things , he and his sons for ever

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּבָּדֵ֣ל אַהֲרֹ֡ן לְֽ הַקְדִּישׁ וֹ֩ קֹ֨דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֤ים הֽוּא וּ בָנָי ו֙ עַד עוֹלָ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ διεστάλη Ἀαρὼν τοῦ ἁγιασθῆναι ἅγια ἁγίων αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ ἕως αἰῶνος ,
traditions.VUL: Separatúsque est Aaron ut ministráret in Sancto sanctórum , ipse et fílii eius in sempitérnum ,
traditions.KJV: and Aaron was separated , that he should sanctify the most holy things , he and his sons for ever ,

13.english_reference: to burn incense before the LORD , to minister unto him , and to bless in his name for ever

traditions.WLC: לְ הַקְטִיר֩ לִ פְנֵ֨י יְהוָ֧ה לְ שָׁרְת֛ וֹ וּ לְ בָרֵ֥ךְ בִּ שְׁמ֖ וֹ עַד עוֹלָֽם
traditions.LXX: τοῦ θυμιᾷν ἐναντίον τοῦ κυρίου , λειτουργεῖν καὶ ἐπεύχεσθαι ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ ἕως αἰῶνος .
traditions.VUL: et adoléret incénsum Dómino secúndum ritum suum , ac benedíceret nómini eius in perpétuum .
traditions.KJV: to burn incense before the LORD , to minister unto him , and to bless in his name for ever .

14.english_reference: Now [ concerning ] Moses the man of God

traditions.WLC: וּ מֹשֶׁ֖ה אִ֣ישׁ הָ אֱלֹהִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ Μωυσῆς ἄνθρωπος τοῦ θεοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Móysi quoque hóminis Dei
traditions.KJV: Now [ concerning ] Moses the man of God ,

14.english_reference: his sons were named of the tribe of Levi

traditions.WLC: בָּנָ֕י ו יִקָּרְא֖וּ עַל שֵׁ֥בֶט הַ לֵּוִֽי
traditions.LXX: υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ ἐκλήθησαν εἰς φυλὴν τοῦ Λευεί .
traditions.VUL: fílii annumeráti sunt in tribu Levi .
traditions.KJV: his sons were named of the tribe of Levi .

15.english_reference: The sons of Moses [ were ] , Gershom , and Eliezer

traditions.WLC: בְּנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה גֵּרְשֹׁ֖ם וֶ אֱלִיעֶֽזֶר
traditions.LXX: υἱοὶ Μωυσῆ · Γηρσὰμ καὶ Ἐλιέζερ .
traditions.VUL: Fílii Móysi : Gersom et Eliézer .
traditions.KJV: The sons of Moses [ were ] , Gershom , and Eliezer .

16.english_reference: Of the sons of Gershom , Shebuel [ was ] the chief

traditions.WLC: בְּנֵ֥י גֵרְשׁ֖וֹם שְׁבוּאֵ֥ל הָ רֹֽאשׁ
traditions.LXX: υἱοὶ Γηρσάμ · Σουβαὴλ ὁ ἄρχων .
traditions.VUL: Fílii Gersom : Súbuel primus .
traditions.KJV: Of the sons of Gershom , Shebuel [ was ] the chief .

17.english_reference: And the sons of Eliezer [ were ] , Rehabiah the chief

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּֽהְי֥וּ בְנֵי אֱלִיעֶ֖זֶר רְחַבְיָ֣ה הָ רֹ֑אשׁ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦσαν υἱοὶ τῷ Ἐλιέζερ Ῥααβιὰ ὁ ἄρχων ,
traditions.VUL: Fuérunt autem fílii Eliézer : Rohobía primus :
traditions.KJV: And the sons of Eliezer [ were ] , Rehabiah the chief .

17.english_reference: And Eliezer had none other sons

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹא הָיָ֤ה לֶ אֱלִיעֶ֨זֶר֙ בָּנִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἦσαν υἱοὶ ἕτεροι ·
traditions.VUL: et non erant Eliézer fílii álii .
traditions.KJV: And Eliezer had none other sons ;

17.english_reference: but the sons of Rehabiah were very many

traditions.WLC: וּ בְנֵ֥י רְחַבְיָ֖ה רָב֥וּ לְ מָֽעְלָ ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ υἱοὶ Ῥααβιὰ ηὐξήθησαν εἰς ὕψος .
traditions.VUL: Porro fílii Rohobía multiplicáti sunt nimis .
traditions.KJV: but the sons of Rehabiah were very many .

18.english_reference: Of the sons of Izhar ; Shelomith the chief

traditions.WLC: בְּנֵ֥י יִצְהָ֖ר שְׁלֹמִ֥ית הָ רֹֽאשׁ
traditions.LXX: υἱοὶ Ἰσσαάρ · Σαλωμὼθ ὁ ἄρχων .
traditions.VUL: Fílii Isaar : Sálomith primus .
traditions.KJV: Of the sons of Izhar ; Shelomith the chief .

19.english_reference: Of the sons of Hebron ; Jeriah the first , Amariah the second , Jahaziel the third , and Jekameam the fourth

traditions.WLC: בְּנֵ֖י חֶבְר֑וֹן יְרִיָּ֤הוּ הָ רֹאשׁ֙ אֲמַרְיָ֣ה הַ שֵּׁנִ֔י יַחֲזִיאֵל֙ הַ שְּׁלִישִׁ֔י וִֽ יקַמְעָ֖ם הָ רְבִיעִֽי
traditions.LXX: υἱῶν Χεβρών · Ἰδοὺδ ὁ ἄρχων , Ἀμαδιὰ ὁ δεύτερος , Ὀζιὴλ ὁ τρίτος , Ἰκεμίας ὁ τέταρτος .
traditions.VUL: Fílii Hebron : Ieríau primus , Amarías secúndus , Iaháziel tértius , Iécmaam quartus .
traditions.KJV: Of the sons of Hebron ; Jeriah the first , Amariah the second , Jahaziel the third , and Jekameam the fourth .

20.english_reference: Of the sons of Uzziel ; Michah the first , and Jesiah the second

traditions.WLC: בְּנֵ֖י עֻזִּיאֵ֑ל מִיכָ֣ה הָ רֹ֔אשׁ וְ יִשִּׁיָּ֖ה הַ שֵּׁנִֽי
traditions.LXX: υἱοὶ Ὀζιήλ · Μειχᾶς ὁ ἄρχων καὶ Ἰσειὰ ὁ δεύτερος .
traditions.VUL: Fílii Oziel : Micha primus , Iesía secúndus .
traditions.KJV: Of the sons of Uzziel ; Michah the first , and Jesiah the second .

21.english_reference: The sons of Merari ; Mahli , and Mushi .

traditions.WLC: בְּנֵ֤י מְרָרִי֙ מַחְלִ֣י וּ מוּשִׁ֔י
traditions.LXX: υἱοὶ Μεραρεί · Μοολεὶ καὶ Ὀμουσεί ·
traditions.VUL: Fílii Merári : Móholi , et Musi .
traditions.KJV: The sons of Merari ; Mahli , and Mushi .

21.english_reference: The sons of Mahli ; Eleazar , and Kish .

traditions.WLC: בְּנֵ֥י מַחְלִ֖י אֶלְעָזָ֥ר וְ קִֽישׁ
traditions.LXX: υἱοὶ Μοήλ · Ἐλεαζὰρ καὶ Κείς .
traditions.VUL: Fílii Móholi : Eleázar , et Cis .
traditions.KJV: The sons of Mahli ; Eleazar , and Kish .

22.english_reference: And Eleazar died , and had no sons , but daughters :

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֨מָת֙ אֶלְעָזָ֔ר וְ לֹא הָ֥יוּ ל֛ וֹ בָּנִ֖ים כִּ֣י אִם בָּנ֑וֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπέθανεν Ἐλεαζάρ , καὶ οὐκ ἦσαν αὐτῷ υἱοὶ ἀλλ᾽ ἢ θυγατέρες ,
traditions.VUL: Mórtuus est autem Eleázar , et non hábuit fílios , sed fílias :
traditions.KJV: And Eleazar died , and had no sons , but daughters :

22.english_reference: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them .

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשָּׂא֥וּ ם בְּנֵי קִ֖ישׁ אֲחֵי הֶֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔλαβον αὐτὰς υἱοὶ Κεὶς ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν .
traditions.VUL: acceperúntque eas fílii Cis fratres eárum .
traditions.KJV: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them .

23.english_reference: The sons of Mushi ; Mahli , and Eder , and Jeremoth , three .

traditions.WLC: בְּנֵ֣י מוּשִׁ֗י מַחְלִ֥י וְ עֵ֛דֶר וִ ירֵמ֖וֹת שְׁלֹשָֽׁה
traditions.LXX: υἱοὶ Μουσεί · Μοολεὶ καὶ Αἶδαθ καὶ Ἀρειμώθ , τρεῖς .
traditions.VUL: Fílii Musi : Móholi , et Eder , et Iérimoth , tres .
traditions.KJV: The sons of Mushi ; Mahli , and Eder , and Jeremoth , three .
